record.title: The bounded payer writes every payment record from literals (Orchard -> Orchard, Shielded, FullPrivacy) and never applies the recipient-policy guard, so a payment whose transaction crosses a shielded pool boundary (a Sapling receiver) would be recorded and scored as a same-pool, fully-shielded, FullPrivacy payment
record.description: payer::run pays each invoice it admitted through ops::propose_shielded_payment / ops::build_sign_broadcast and then records the payment at payer.rs:339-362, where pool_in: Pool::Orchard (349), pool_out: Pool::Orchard (350), kind: PaymentKind::Shielded (351) and policy: Some("FullPrivacy") (352) are constants: none is derived from the proposal or the transaction, and payer.rs never reads the proposal back (0 occurrences of proposal.steps / payment_pools / any transaction decryption, against ops.rs:1076-1126 where `pay` decrypts the mined transaction). observation/src/lib.rs:28-30 defines PaymentKind::Shielded as "shielded source and shielded destination, same pool" and 56-60 defines pool_out as the payment's destination pool and `policy` as "the privacy policy argument the flow passed to its wallet layer, verbatim" - the payer passes no such argument. This path also never calls ops::required_policy_for_recipient + ops::check_policy (payer.rs: 0 call sites; every other payment path does: ops.rs:563-566, 777, 1019-1020; flow.rs:633-634, 826-827), and ops::propose_shielded_payments (payer.rs:306-307 -> ops.rs:900-961) applies SpendPolicy::shielded_pools([Orchard]) to input sources only (zcash_client_backend 0.24.0 input_selection.rs:476-489, 966-968, 999-1003). The recipient comes from the merchant's invoice file, deserialized directly (payer.rs:495-519, no ZIP-321 cross-check unlike flow.rs:1740-1768), and decide only string-compares it against the grant allowlist (payer.rs:100); an empty or absent allowlist admits every receiver (printed at payer.rs:222-224). A merchant-supplied invoice naming a Sapling receiver therefore reaches the wallet layer: verifier-2 reproduced this in the offline sandbox - the payer's own intake took the dev account's bare zregtestsapling1 receiver and a Sapling-only UA to "Must scan blocks first" (fundless stub wallet, identical to the Orchard control), while required_policy_for_recipient + check_policy refuse those same recipients under FullPrivacy with "would reveal the amount (Orchard -> Sapling pool crossing)" (ops.rs:243-246). The record then decides every verdict derived from it: policy-downgrade (Severity::Disqualifying) computes its explicit signal from Payment.policy (76-89; "FullPrivacy" matches no downgrade fragment) and its implicit signal from pool_in (shielded) plus pool_out in {Transparent, CrossPool} (92-101), so the payer's constant record makes it PASS - reproduced with zanary_properties::evaluate() in the sandbox, where the fixtures' honest cross-pool record (fixtures.rs:243-246) FAILs as a positive control. Nothing re-derives a pool leg afterwards: report/src/verify.rs re-checks tx height / receiver / memo / pool totals as report evidence and the report crate never mentions pool_in/pool_out, and no property compares run.payments against the ledger or the chain. Calibration: the flow runner writes the same Orchard/Orchard/Shielded constants (flow.rs:687-690, 984-987) but records the real policy token and does gate recipients, and the property's implicit signal does not cover pool_out Sapling at all - the record lie is what turns an undetected crossing into a recorded, scored "fully private" payment.
record.claimed_root_cause: Two coupled defects on the payer's pay path: (1) the record fields the leak properties read are literals - pool_in/pool_out/kind/policy at payer.rs:349-352 are never derived from the proposal's payment pools or from the built transaction, so they describe what the payer assumed rather than what it built; (2) the payer is the only payment path in the workspace that does not call ops::required_policy_for_recipient + ops::check_policy before proposing (0 call sites in payer.rs against ops.rs:563-566/777/1019-1020 and flow.rs:633-634/826-827), so a merchant-supplied recipient that makes the payment reveal more than FullPrivacy (a Sapling receiver, which the target's own intake accepts and hands to the wallet layer) is paid instead of refused, and is then recorded as Orchard -> Orchard Shielded FullPrivacy.

trace.scope: payer::run - the payment loop over the invoices decide allowed
trace.description: The merchant-supplied receiver (deserialized straight from the invoice JSON at payer.rs:495-519, with no ZIP-321 cross-check unlike flow.rs:1740-1768) is decoded into the address the payment will be made to; there is no recipient-kind or privacy-policy gate anywhere on this path (payer.rs has 0 occurrences of check_policy / required_policy_for_recipient).

The recipient becomes a ZIP-321 payment handed to propose_transfer with SpendPolicy::shielded_pools([Orchard]) (inputs only; 929) and an Orchard change strategy (931-936), so nothing constrains the recipient's own pool. Reproduced: a bare Sapling receiver and a Sapling-only UA pass this intake and reach the wallet layer ("Must scan blocks first" in a fundless stub wallet), while required_policy_for_recipient + check_policy refuse the same recipients under FullPrivacy (ops.rs:243-246).

Whatever the proposal built is proved, signed, read back from the wallet (396-402) and sent to the indexer (407-415) without any comparison against the invoice the payer decided about and without inspecting the transaction's pools.

trace.scope: payer::run - the Payment record written for the payment just broadcast
trace.description: pool_in, pool_out, kind and policy are written as constants (349-352: Orchard / Orchard / Shielded / FullPrivacy), so the run's evidence - and the findings, report and index built from it - assert a same-pool, fully-shielded, FullPrivacy payment regardless of the transaction's real shape; policy-downgrade (Disqualifying) reads exactly these fields and passes (reproduced).

evidence.description: the four fields policy-downgrade reads are literals: pool_in: Pool::Orchard (349), pool_out: Pool::Orchard (350), kind: PaymentKind::Shielded (351), policy: Some("FullPrivacy") (352); payer.rs reads nothing back (0 occurrences of proposal.steps / payment_pools / decrypt - verifier-2's sandbox count over the compiled file)

required_policy_for_recipient maps a Sapling receiver (or a UA with a Sapling receiver and no Orchard receiver, 250-254) to AllowRevealedAmounts because the payment would reveal "the amount (Orchard -> Sapling pool crossing)" (243-246)

the CLI pay path calls check_policy before proposing (1019-1020); ops.rs:563-566 (anchor), ops.rs:777 (shield) and flow.rs:633-634 / 826-827 do the same; payer.rs has no equivalent (0 occurrences, verifier-2 sandbox count)

the implicit-downgrade signal is computed from Payment.pool_in/pool_out alone (92-101; reveal requires pool_out Transparent|CrossPool) and the explicit one from Payment.policy (76-89; "FullPrivacy" matches no fragment), so the constant record decides the verdict - reproduced: zanary_properties::evaluate() returns PASS for the payer's record and FAIL for the fixtures' honest cross-pool control
policy-downgrade is Severity::Disqualifying (54-56), so the false PASS is published as a clean verdict for a run whose payment actually crossed a shielded pool boundary

PaymentKind::Shielded is defined as "shielded source and shielded destination, same pool" (28-30); pool_out is the payment's destination pool and `policy` the "privacy policy argument the flow passed to its wallet layer, verbatim" (56-60) - recording Orchard/Shielded/FullPrivacy for a Sapling-output payment is false by the model's own definitions, and the payer passed no such argument

the fixture that models a cross-pool payment records the real destination pool (pool_in Orchard, pool_out Transparent, kind CrossPool, policy AllowRevealedAmounts; 243-246) and drives the property's failing path - used here as the positive control that the property bites when the record is honest
the harness chain activates Sapling at height 1 (84-96) while NU6.1/6.2/6.3 (Ironwood) stay unactivated, so a Sapling output is the shielded cross-pool delivery this build can produce

dependency source (version pinned by Cargo.toml:20, vendored read-only): GreedyInputSelector::propose_transaction delivers an Address::Sapling recipient through a Sapling output with payment_pools[idx] = SAPLING (966-968; a Sapling-only UA at 999-1003), and SpendPolicy::shielded_pools constrains input sources only (476-489) - so the transaction built for a Sapling-receiver invoice carries the Sapling leg the record denies (source-corroborated; not executed - see blockers)

calibration: the flow runner writes the same Orchard/Orchard/Shielded constants (687-690, 984-987) but records the real policy token (Some(policy.name())) and calls the guard at 633-634 / 826-827 - the template pattern is shared, while the missing guard is specific to the payer

`zanary-report verify` re-derives tx height / receiver / memo / pool-total evidence from the chain, and the report crate never mentions pool_in/pool_out (0 occurrences): nothing re-derives or cross-checks the recorded pool legs
the decision only string-compares the receiver against the grant allowlist; an empty or absent allowlist admits every receiver and is printed as such at 222-224

blockers: The decisive step - that the proposal/transaction built for a Sapling-receiver invoice carries a Sapling output - could not be executed in the approved sandbox: it needs a wallet holding a spendable Orchard note, and no offline route exists (zcash_client_backend's test-wallet framework needs the test-dependencies feature set -> proptest/ambassador/assert_matches, none of which are in the read-only registry cache - verifier-2 confirmed the cache holds only incrementalmerkletree/rand_chacha/tempfile of that set - and --network=none permits no fetch). The leg is Sapling by source (input_selection.rs:966-968, 999-1003); execution is what is missing.

The end of the path - the broadcast, the mined transaction's shape, and the report/index published from the run - needs the regtest rig (its containers and host ports 18232/18233/9067/9068), which is out of bounds.

Whether a Sapling-receiver invoice ever reaches a payer in practice is a deployment fact: every recorded run on this host and the CI demo issue Orchard-only invoices with a 3-receiver allowlist (data/grants/*.json, data/demo-payer/invoices/*.json, scripts/bounded-payer-demo.sh), while the payer's contract is any invoice directory and no observation of a Sapling-receiver invoice reaching a payer exists.

validation_plan.local: In a sandbox whose registry cache is populated (or with network for the one fetch), build zcash_client_backend and zcash_client_sqlite with `test-dependencies`, fund one Orchard note in their data_api::testing test wallet, then call propose_transfer with the payer's exact arguments (params = core::regtest_network(), account, GreedyInputSelector::new(), SingleOutputChangeStrategy::new(Zip317, None, ShieldedPool::Orchard, DustOutputPolicy::default()), ConfirmationsPolicy::default(), SpendPolicy::shielded_pools([Orchard]), request = one zip321 payment to a zregtestsapling1... receiver carrying the invoice memo - ops.rs:929-961) and print proposal.steps()[0].payment_pools() - expected {0: PoolType::SAPLING}: the payment leg is Sapling while payer.rs:350 would record Orchard. Without that framework, verifier-2 already re-established everything short of the proposal in /t (crates/probe/src/bin/verifier2_check.rs; output check-verify2.txt): payer.rs:349-352 are literals and payer.rs calls neither guard; the Sapling receiver reaches the wallet layer through the payer's own intake while required_policy_for_recipient + check_policy refuse it; zanary_properties::evaluate() gives the constant record policy-downgrade PASS (and the fixtures' honest cross-pool record FAIL).
validation_plan.deployment: Owner-observed on the regtest rig (throwaway funds, no external network, nothing touched outside a fresh --out directory): write one invoice JSON whose receiver is the dev account's own Sapling receiver with a self-consistent URI (zcash:?address=<zregtestsapling1...>&amount=<...>) and a short memo, plus a grant with an empty allowlist (or that receiver listed); run `zanary-probe payer --grant <grant.json> --invoices <dir> --out <fresh-dir>`; then read (a) run.json payments[0].pool_in/pool_out/kind/policy (expected the constants Orchard/Orchard/Shielded/FullPrivacy), (b) findings.json / report.json policy-downgrade verdict (expected PASS), (c) the txid via getrawtransaction/decoderawtransaction (expected a Sapling output and a non-zero sapling valueBalance). Non-destructive control on the same invoice (refuses before proposing or broadcasting): `zanary-probe pay --invoice <the same file> --policy FullPrivacy` must refuse at ops.rs:1019-1020 with "would reveal the amount (Orchard -> Sapling pool crossing)".
